mapper.insert: INSERT INTO td_sync_cursor (symbol, "interval", last_bar_time, last_sync_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{interval}, #{lastBarTime}, now()) ON CONFLICT (symbol, "interval") DO UPDATE SET last_bar_time = EXCLUDED.last_bar_time, last_sync_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, "interval", last_bar_time, last_sync_at FROM td_sync_cursor WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND "interval" = #{interval}
